params.body: With request header X-Timing-Detail: groups the response carries X-Query-Group-1..12: the statements of the request grouped by shape (bindings stripped), how often each ran and their summed time. Finds an N+1 in one request; /exports still runs 87 queries after #185 and the slowest-eight view does not show which shape repeats.
params.title: Server-Timing detail: query groups
